spans.s:
The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'collection thereof' after the names of things without consciousness and after 1. हस्ति and 2. धेनु।

Terms: ठक्

After a word denoting a thing not having consciousness, but not being the name of a country or time, the affix ठक् is used in the sense of 'this is his object of devotion or love'.

Terms: ठक्

There is the substitution of शीर्ष for शीरस् when a तद्धित-affix beginning with a vowel follows.

Terms: तद्धित

Before an affix beginning with a vowel there are substituted for उ of नु , the characteristic of the roots of the स्वादिगणः (5th Conjugation) for the final इ , ई , उ and ऊ of a root, as well as for ऊ of भ्रू , the इय् (for इ or ई) and उव् (for उ or ऊ).

Terms: इवङ्-उवङ्

र् is substituted for ऋ of तिसृ and चतसृ before the case-affixes beginning with a vowel.

Terms: सर्वनाम

ल् is optionally changed to ल् before an affix beginning with a vowel.

Terms: र् changed to ल्
